# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Feb 11, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on CI/CD pipeline improvements, significant documentation porting for `op-reth`, and general code maintenance. Several issues related to Rust migration and CI configurations were resolved.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### CI/CD Pipeline Enhancements and Fixes
Multiple fixes and improvements were implemented in the CI/CD pipelines. This included renaming continuation config parameters to avoid overlaps ([#19142](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19142)), correcting the path for Kona prestate artifact publication ([#19130](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19130)), and resolving a syntax error in the Rust CI configuration ([#19144](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19144)). Additionally, the `main` and `acceptance-test` workflows were merged to avoid duplicate work and optimize compute time ([#19108](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19108)).

### `op-reth` Documentation Porting
Extensive documentation for `op-reth` was ported from the upstream `reth` repository, including the OP Stack running guide, sync FAQ, and a comprehensive CLI reference. This involved adding a new Vocs-based documentation site ([#18968](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18968)).

### Rust Crate Refinements and Batcher Metrics
The unused `kona-batcher-comp` crate was removed, along with its associated files and documentation, to streamline the codebase ([#18972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18972)). Metrics recording was added to the `op-batcher` before sending to the throttling loop, ensuring metrics are tracked even when throttling is disabled ([#19138](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19138)). Furthermore, `check-no-std` recipes were consolidated into the root `justfile` for Rust crates ([#19154](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19154)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#19165](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19165) feat(op-node): add NUT bundle parser for JSON-defined upgrade transactions
- [#19163](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19163) proofs: port TestInteropFaultProofs action test to devstack
- [#19162](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19162) chore(rust/op-reth): update reth to rev 2c5d00f and bump alloy deps
- [#19161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19161) dependabot(gomod): bump golang.org/x/crypto from 0.37.0 to 0.48.0
- [#19160](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19160) dependabot(gomod): bump golang.org/x/mod from 0.24.0 to 0.33.0
- [#19159](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19159) dependabot(gomod): bump golang.org/x/tools from 0.32.0 to 0.42.0
- [#19158](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19158) dependabot(gomod): bump go.etcd.io/bbolt from 1.3.5 to 1.4.3
- [#19155](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19155) feat(release/rust): set up release process for rust crates
- [#19153](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19153) chore(ci/rust): run rust CI on changes to circleci
- [#19152](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19152) feat(rollup-boost): port rollup-boost to the monorepo
- [#19150](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19150) fix(op-node): add SetCodeTxType check to span batch validation
- [#19149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19149) conductor: Fix nil pointer in Raft snapshot
- [#19148](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19148) Fix/stop sequencer deadlock
- [#19147](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19147) op-proposer: add skipped L2 blocks gauge
- [#19145](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19145) fix(ci): fix rust-ci.yml syntax and missing job definitions

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Kona Prestate and Cannon Integration
The issue of using the monorepo cannon to build Kona prestates was resolved, moving away from a pinned version of cannon that was an artifact of Kona existing in a separate repository ([#19143](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19143)). This also addressed the need to use a single bucket and path for both `op-program` and Kona prestates in CI ([#18782](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18782)).

### `op-reth` Migration and Documentation
Several issues related to the `op-reth` migration were closed. This included porting `op-reth` documentation from the upstream `reth` repository ([#18969](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18969)), migrating example crates that depend on `op-reth` from `paradigmxyz/reth` ([#18918](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18918)), and removing the `reth` submodule while updating CI to use `op-reth` ([#18919](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18919)).

### Rust Crate Unification and Configuration
Efforts to unify Rust crates into a single workspace were completed ([#18930](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18930)), along with the consolidation of Zepter configurations across different Rust repositories ([#18931](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18931)).

### Kona Game Type Enablement
The issue to enable `CANNON_KONA` as a respected game type after the Kona audit was closed, indicating progress in updating the `RESPECTED_GAME_TYPE_CANNON_KONA` dev feature flag ([#19116](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19116)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Development Feature Flags and Dependencies
A new issue highlights a cyclic dependency problem with development feature flags, which are currently hardcoded as hex values in multiple places. The proposal is to use a single source of truth with named constants ([#19151](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19151)).

### Supernode Caching and Sync Status
An issue was opened to consider adding full safe block reference caching to the supernode to avoid network calls to the EL, aiming to improve the accuracy of the virtual node's sync status ([#19146](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19146)).

### CI/CD and Documentation Automation
New issues propose setting up an automated CI workflow to update `crates.io` on new tags for Rust crates ([#19156](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19156)) and adding a script to automatically update CLI documentation, similar to what Reth uses ([#19157](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19157)).

### Cannon Go 1.26 Compatibility
An investigation into Go 1.26 compatibility for Cannon has been initiated to estimate the work required for support ([#19164](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19164)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Kona Proofs Outdated Just Recipes ([#18654](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18654))
Discussion continues regarding the removal of custom `just` recipes for building `kona-host/client`. While the issue was previously closed, it was reopened due to a remaining TODO in the code. The latest comment from Inphi suggests that these recipes are still necessary for developers to build prestates during local testing, despite the monorepo now being used for prestate building.

### L2CM Upgrades Risk Modeling ([#18869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18869))
Maurelian provided templates for risk modeling (FMA) and referenced an existing OPCMv2 FMA, guiding the ongoing effort to perform risk modeling for the L2CM design.

### `op-alloy` Docs Deployment ([#18929](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18929))
Theochap linked to a pull request ([#19101](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19101)) that is likely addressing the deployment of `op-alloy` documentation to the Optimism namespace and updating the README link.
